sara_customer: Hey team — after the 2026-03-15 runtime deploy our customers started hitting parse failures in structured JSON mode. They see a schema validation error for invoice objects (number vs string + missing boolean).

alice_support: Can you paste a short repro request + the failing response? Also which customer / plan?

sara_customer: customer: paylane-inc (dedicated). Quick sample request we use: `POST /v1/generate` with payload: ```json
{
  \"model\": \"redwood-alpha-1\",
  \"mode\": \"structured_json\",
  \"prompt\": \"return invoice JSON for id=384\"
}```

sara_customer: Failing response (from their client logs): ```json
{
  \"invoice\": {
    \"id\": \"384\",
    \"total\": \"120.00\",      // sometimes string, sometimes number
    \"paid\": null                   // sometimes null, sometimes field is omitted entirely
  }
}```

alice_support: Got it. Error they send back to us is a schema mismatch in strict mode: "invoice.total expected number got string" and "invoice.paid missing but schema wasn't optional".

alice_support: tagging eng — @tom_engineer can you look? We may need a quick mitigation.

inference-bot: Noted deployment activity at 2026-03-15T08:12:03Z — model adapter `redwood-alpha-1` updated kernels and output templating.

tom_engineer: Thanks. First pass: looks like the model's output templates changed subtlely — it started quoting numeric totals when using short formatting and omitted explicit nulls for optional booleans. That causes strict JSON schema validation to fail on customers using strict mode.

mike_se: Is this only on Dedicated for Paylane or also on Hosted customers? We should check logs for both.

tom_engineer: Quick check: hosted telemetry shows ~18 calls with the same pattern in the same minute window; dedicated Paylane is the most frequent failure. So regression rolled to several customers.

nina_qa: Repro steps I used locally: curl -> request above -> got output where total is a string and paid omitted. Repro script: ```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha-1","mode":"structured_json","prompt":"invoice id=384"}' | jq .
```

alice_support: Customer asked for a workaround they can apply today — any suggestions?

tom_engineer: Short-term workaround: set the API param `json_mode.strict=false` (relaxed mode) so the client will coerce types/accept missing fields. Or post-process on their side to coerce `invoice.total` to number and treat missing `paid` as false/null. We'll push a server-side patch tomorrow to coerce output types for stable schema.

mike_se: Can we also add a compatibility layer in the serving runtime that normalizes quoted numbers to numbers and ensures nullable fields are present (explicit null) when schema says nullable? That would avoid customer code changes.

tom_engineer: Yes — plan: add an output normalizer in the response filter chain that: (1) attempts to parse numeric strings into numbers for fields defined as numeric in the model schema, (2) inserts explicit null for nullable boolean/enum fields if omitted, and (3) logs any coercions as warn-level with request id. Implementing now, will run canary on staging.

alice_support: ETA for deploy? Customer requests ASAP.

tom_engineer: Can do a hotfix to the filter and canary to 10% of hosts in ~3 hours. Full rollout after 6 hours if no regressions.

inference-bot: Canary rollout started at 2026-03-16T11:45:00Z — 10% traffic.

sara_customer: Thanks, please cc customer success when canary looks good, they want a heads-up before we change behavior.

mike_se: Also adding unit tests and a small synthetic eval that asserts: numeric fields must parse from quoted numbers and nullable flags must be present as either true/false/null.

alice_support: I'll send Paylane the short-term instructions (strict=false + client coercion) and keep them updated on the canary.

tom_engineer: Patch merged to staging branch. If canary looks clean we'll promote. I'll follow up with the exact changepack.

alice_support: Thanks all — marking as escalation in Zendesk ticket #ZD-4512 and will update customer after canary metrics. :thumbsup:

sara_customer: Appreciate it.
